title: Bad person
overview: Nafar Mu Zayn" is a hysteric Bahraini YouTube parody influenced by the kingdoms expatriate worker community with an attempted mashup of Khaleej and heightened flare of Bollywood. Filmed along the "Little India" streets and in the midst of bustling Manama, a portrayal of integrity and survival. This is the story of Sikandar, Maqbul and Akbar.
